title: Task progress request
description: POST /api/v1/tasks/<id>/progress (FR-3.2, P3-S04). Optional: a running task's progress, for task types where the agent can tell. Only for a task the server accepted as started. The host is the credential's host, never a field in the body; a task of another host, or an unknown id, is 404 not_found.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. This directory is version 1.

percent.description: How far the task has got, as a whole percentage; null when the agent cannot tell.
